page.layout: One page of text. Above: a verse poem in italic, ending with the initials "I. I. B." right-aligned. Below a printed ornament rule: a title block in capitals and roman with a second line, then a second verse poem with a large woodcut initial V. Signature "E. ij." at the lower right. No margin notes.

l.i: conscia[?] partus Obtedit terris, prima Nauarre dies,
Guisiadem ad stygias inssit[?] penetrare paludes,
A uitior ut duplici luceat usque nota.
Nam te praesidium patriae dedit illa ruenti
Hic semper cuius pestis acerba fuit.

page.notes: Ornamental rule and historiated/woodcut initial V are decoration, not text. Doubtful: "conscia" (superscript final letter, read as a) and "inssit" (letters as printed; the reading "iussit" is expected but the print shows "inssit"). "Fundaq;" with the q-abbreviation is read from the scan and may be "Fundaeq;". The underlined Q in "QVA" and "Quae" is printed as a ligature-like mark and is copied as Q/QV. Show-through of the reverse page is visible in the right margin and is omitted. A small ink spot lies over "DVX".
